description: The format for NSR keys.  They always start with four numbers.  Two letters follow; currently case is not enforced, although the preferred case is on capitalized letter followed by a lower-case letter.  Finally, there are either two numbers or two letters (preferred capitalized, but not currently enforced).  Note that they are grouped in an array; this handles cases when publications are related, e.g. a conference proceedings and a later journal article describing the same data.
